en: Every accepted Scan uses 1 Genesis Core and creates unique private art. Linked Seekers automatically receive 1 Core every 7 server days while their free balance is below 3.

Bits buy food and items in the Shop. Winning Battle grants Bits based on rival strength, up to 100 Bits each local day. The first three wins also grant EXP and a recorded win. Training after that can still earn Bits until the daily cap. Clean is free.
